Thank you all for raising these important points. Let me address each one:

Imani, thank you for flagging your caregiving constraint. A remote-only window from 13:00–16:00 is something we need to accommodate. That means the afternoon portion of the retreat will need a remote-accessible format.

Leo, I appreciate you raising the concern about Alex and Sam. I agree we should formally record those two incidents and prohibit supervisor-employee pairings during the exercises.

Ruth, this is critical — the three procedural safeguards you've identified (written opt-in before conflict-repair exercises, a neutral facilitator instead of a manager-led reflection, and exactly two follow-up check-ins) are mandatory requirements. The current draft clearly doesn't meet them. We'll need to revise the plan to incorporate all three.

Given everything raised, here's what I'm thinking for the revised plan: We keep the full-day in-person format but restructure it so the afternoon session (13:00–16:00) is accessible remotely for Imani and anyone else who needs it. We replace the manager-led reflection with a neutral facilitator. We add written opt-in before any conflict-repair or paired exercise. We prohibit supervisor-employee pairings. We formally record the two prior incidents Leo observed. And we schedule exactly two follow-up check-ins after the event.

I'll incorporate all of this into the revised draft before I continue my round-robin consultation. Does anyone have concerns with this direction before I proceed?
